'''Thulin''' is a blacksmith and neighbor to [[Renald Fanwar]].

== Appearance ==
He is lean for a smith, and his skin is tan.  He shaves his face, but does not wear the traditional topknot of a [[Shienaran]].  He is getting old for a blacksmith.

== History ==
He has a young daughter, [[Mirala]]. He has been married to his wife, [[Gallanha]], for twenty five years. 

== Activities ==
He has packed up all of his essential belongings and headed north toward [[The Blight]] to join the armies gathering for [[Tarmon Gai'don]].
